items.source: resumeToken - must not be null.
items.translation: resumeToken 不能为 null。

items.source: Set the MessageListener event messages will be published to.
items.translation: 设置将发布到MessageListener事件的messages。

items.source: Set the FullDocument lookup to FullDocument.UPDATE_LOOKUP.
items.translation: 将FullDocument查询设置为FullDocument.UPDATE_LOOKUP。

items.source: Set the resume token (typically a BsonDocument containing a binary token) after which to start with listening.
items.translation: 设置恢复令牌（通常是一个包含binary token的BsonDocument），从此处开始监听。

items.source: Set the name of the MongoCollection to listen to.
items.translation: 设置要监听的MongoCollection的名称。

items.source: Set the name of the MongoDatabase to listen to.
items.translation: 将要监听的MongoDatabase的名称设置为此值。

items.source: Set the FullDocumentBeforeChange lookup to the given value.
items.translation: 将 `<code>FullDocumentBeforeChange` 查找设置为给定值。

items.source: Set the collation to use.
items.translation: 要使用的排序规则。

items.source: Set the plain filter chain to apply.
items.translation: 启用普通过滤器链。

items.source: Set the cursors maximum wait time on the server (for a new Document to be emitted).
items.translation: 在服务器上设置游标的最大等待时间（用于新文档的发布）。

items.source: Set the resume token after which to continue emitting notifications.
items.translation: 设置恢复令牌，用于继续发出通知。

items.source: Set the cluster time at which to resume listening.
items.translation: 设置恢复监听时的集群时间。

items.source: Set whether expanded change events (e.g. createIndexes, shardCollection) should be emitted.
items.translation: 设置是否应发出扩展变更事件（例如 createIndexes、shardCollection）。

items.source: Set the resume token after which to start emitting notifications.
items.translation: 设置恢复令牌，从此令牌之后开始发出通知。

items.source:
Set the filter to apply.
Fields on aggregation expression root level are prefixed to map to fields contained in fullDocument. However operationType, ns, documentKey and fullDocument are reserved words that will be omitted, and therefore taken as given, during the mapping procedure. You may want to have a look at the structure of Change Events.
Use TypedAggregation to ensure filter expressions are mapped to domain type fields.
items.translation:
设置要应用的过滤器。
聚合表达式根级别的字段前缀用于映射到 fullDocument 中包含的字段。然而，operationType、ns、documentKey 和 fullDocument 是保留字，在映射过程中将被省略并视为已知项。您可能需要查看变更事件的结构。
使用 TypedAggregation 可确保过滤器表达式被映射到领域类型字段。

items.source: Builder for creating ChangeStreamRequest.
items.translation: 用于创建ChangeStreamRequest的构建器。

items.source: Set the filter to apply.
items.translation: 设置要应用的筛选器。

items.source: aggregation - the Aggregation pipeline to apply for filtering events. Must not be null.
items.translation: aggregation - 用于过滤事件的聚合管道。不能为 null。

items.source: showExpandedEvents - true to include expanded events.
items.translation: showExpandedEvents - 设置为 true 以包含已展开的事件。

items.source: the build ChangeStreamRequest.
items.translation: 构建ChangeStreamRequest。
